(17) 'Rent' (a) Means the amount charged for a sleeping room/space ... including the following, regardless of whether separately stated: (i) Charges that would normally be part of an all inclusive room rate, such as, but not limited to, payment processing fees, check-in fees, accommodation fees, facility fees, access fees, charges for additional guests, late check-out fees, and utility surcharges
https://www.clarkcountynv.gov/adobe/asse.establishes: 13.38% is the combined transient lodging tax for a resort hotel inside the primary gaming corridor (12.5% + 0.88%), and the ordinance's definition of 'rent' includes separately stated accommodation, facility and access fees - which is why this site taxes the room rate AND the mandatory resort fee. The document is the ordinance as published for the Board hearing; the rate schedule was effective 2017-03-01 and the page warns rates may be changed by the jurisdictions, so the multiplier is stated with that caveat.
